library_option.name: library
library_option.description: Path to the source library to open.

commands.name: configure_library
commands.summary: Set library defaults, numbering increments, editor, or build command.

options.name: build_command
options.description: Shell command to run after expansion. The output file or directory is available as $1.

options.name: comment-prefix
options.description: Default comment prefix for new decks in the current version.

options.name: editor
options.description: Editor executable and arguments as a JSON array.

options.name: revision_increment
options.description: Step for new revisions of a deck, in thousandths. The default is 0.001.

options.name: version_increment
options.description: Step for automatically starting a library version, in hundredths. The default is 0.01.

commands.help: Specify at least one option. Set the default prefix before the current version receives its first revision. Supply editor arguments as a JSON array and quote the build command as one string.

commands.name: create_deck
commands.summary: Create an empty deck or initialize it from a file.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the new deck.

arguments.name: from_file
arguments.description: Path to the initial source. Omit to create an empty deck.

options.name: comment-prefix
options.description: Comment prefix for this deck. Omit to use the current version's default.

commands.help: Create the first revision of a new deck in the open version. Set its comment prefix with --comment-prefix. An existing deck name, including one inherited from a previous version, is an error.

examples.description: Use the file's bytes as the initial source.

commands.name: diff_deck
commands.summary: Compare stored deck source at two revisions or versions.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck to compare in both snapshots.

arguments.name: from_snapshot
arguments.description: Deck version, scu$current_deck_version, or scu$previous_deck_version. Omit to use the deck version immediately before the right endpoint.

arguments.name: to_snapshot
arguments.description: Deck version, scu$current_deck_version, or scu$previous_deck_version. Omit to use the deck's latest version.

commands.help: Compare the original deck bytes at two deck versions such as 1.04-0.007. scu$current_deck_version and scu$previous_deck_version select the latest and preceding versions of the named deck.

examples.description: Compare the last modified deck with its prior revision.
Compare two exact deck versions within one library version.
Compare an exact deck version with the latest version of the deck.
Compare the latest revision of main.pas with its preceding revision.

commands.name: display_command
commands.summary: Show a command's help and its arguments and options.

arguments.name: command_name
arguments.description: Full command name or alias to look up.

commands.help: Use a full command name or alias. Example: display_command command_name=extd.

commands.name: display_command_list
commands.summary: List commands alphabetically with aliases and short descriptions.
commands.help: Run display_command command_name=NAME for details about a command.

commands.name: display_deck
commands.summary: List a deck's versions and UTC modification times, newest first.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck whose revision history to show.

commands.help: Show each stored revision with its library revision number, library version, UTC modification time, and deck version.

examples.description: Show the revision history of the last modified deck.

commands.name: display_deck_list
commands.summary: List decks and their deck versions in the selected snapshot.

options.name: revision
options.description: Library-wide snapshot after the specified saved change. Revision 0 is empty.

options.name: version
options.description: Latest snapshot of a named version, including inherited decks.

commands.help: Show each deck name and its deck version in the selected snapshot. Inherited decks retain their stored deck version. Specify either revision or version.

examples.description: See which decks are available in named version 1.1.
Inspect the deck list immediately after the seventh saved deck change.
List decks in the latest saved snapshot of the current version.

commands.name: display_expansion_checkpoints
commands.summary: List SQLite expansion checkpoints and their last successful builds.
commands.help: Show each SQLite expansion checkpoint's version, absolute output directory, revision, rebuild status, and the last successful build's revision and UTC time.

commands.name: display_library
commands.summary: Show the library path, versions, and full configuration.
commands.help: Show the library path, current version, and most recent locked predecessor, followed by the full configuration header, including the editor and build command. SCU also runs this command when opening an existing library at a terminal.

commands.name: edit_deck
commands.summary: Edit an existing deck with the configured external editor.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the existing deck to edit.

commands.help: Open the stored deck in the configured editor. Save a new revision when the bytes change.

commands.name: expand_deck
commands.summary: Expand COPY directives and date/time macros into a file.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck to expand.

arguments.name: output_file
arguments.description: Path to write the expanded source.

options.name: build
options.description: Run the configured build command after writing the expanded file.

options.name: comment-prefix
options.description: Temporarily override the comment prefix for all decks visited in this expansion.

options.name: revision
options.description: Library-wide snapshot after the specified saved change. Revision 0 is empty.

options.name: version
options.description: Latest snapshot of a named version, including inherited decks.

commands.help: Resolve COPY directives and substitute macros using one library snapshot. The configured build command runs after expansion unless build=no.

examples.description: Generate compiler input for named version 1.1, resolving COPY from that version.
Recreate compiler input from the library snapshot immediately after revision 7.
Expand the last modified deck to a file with the same name in the current directory.

commands.name: expand_modified_decks
commands.summary: Expand decks changed in a version, with incremental builds for SQLite.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Version whose changed decks to expand.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Existing directory for the expanded source files.

options.name: build
options.description: Run the configured build command once after writing the batch.

options.name: comment-prefix
options.description: Temporarily override the comment prefix for all decks visited in this expansion.

commands.help: Expand decks changed in the selected version into an existing directory. By default, use the current library version and the directory containing the library. SQLite expands changes since the checkpoint, including direct and indirect COPY dependents. A successful build advances the checkpoint. With no configured build command, a successful expansion advances it. Save pending SQLite edits before running the batch.

commands.name: extract_deck
commands.summary: Write the original source bytes to a file.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck to extract.

arguments.name: output_file
arguments.description: Path to write the original source bytes.

options.name: revision
options.description: Library-wide snapshot after the specified saved change. Revision 0 is empty.

options.name: version
options.description: Latest snapshot of a named version, including inherited decks.

commands.help: Write the original source, including COPY directives and macro text, to the output file.

examples.description: Retrieve the source from named version 1.1, such as a locked release.
Recover the source as it stood after revision 7, before a fix saved in revision 8.
Write the last modified deck's original bytes to a file with the same name in the current directory.

commands.name: extract_modified_decks
commands.summary: Extract every deck changed in a version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Version whose changed decks to extract.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Existing directory for the extracted source files.

commands.help: Write the original source of each deck changed in the selected version to an existing directory.

commands.name: initialize_library
commands.summary: Create an empty source library.
commands.help: Initialize the selected library with an open version 1.0.

commands.name: list_versions
commands.summary: List versions and their snapshot boundaries.
commands.help: Print the version, lock state, base revision, and end revision.

commands.name: lock_version
commands.summary: Lock the current version against further changes.
commands.help: Lock the current version and prevent further deck changes until a new version is started.

commands.name: quit_session
commands.summary: Leave the interactive session.

arguments.name: save_library
arguments.description: Save pending changes before quitting. Accepts yes/y or no/n.

commands.help: Exit the interactive session. Pending library changes are saved by default. Use quit save_library=no to discard them.

commands.name: recover_library
commands.summary: Restore an SCU recovery file to a new SQLite library.

arguments.name: recovery_file
arguments.description: SCU recovery JSON file to restore.

options.name: base_library
options.description: Saved SQLite snapshot if the pending-only file references saved revisions.

commands.help: Restore to a new library at the selected path. If a pending-only file references saved revisions, supply the matching saved snapshot as base_library.

commands.name: reset_expansion_checkpoint
commands.summary: Require a full rebuild for one SQLite version and output directory.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version of the checkpoint to reset.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Existing output directory of the checkpoint to reset.

commands.help: Mark an existing SQLite checkpoint for a full rebuild. The next expand_modified_decks run for this version and directory expands every deck in the selected snapshot. A successful build clears the reset. With no configured build command, a successful expansion clears it.

commands.name: save_library
commands.summary: Save pending library changes.
commands.help: Save the current library without leaving the session.

commands.name: show_history
commands.summary: Show recent commands from the library audit trail.

arguments.name: number_of_lines
arguments.description: Maximum number of recent command attempts to display.

commands.help: Show recent audited commands in chronological order, with their canonical names, arguments, options, and outcomes.

commands.name: show_library
commands.summary: Show the library header as JSON.
commands.help: Display the library header, including version history, the editor, and the build command, in JSON.

commands.name: start_version
commands.summary: Start a higher version after locking the current version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: New library version. Omit to advance by version_increment.

commands.help: Lock the current version first. Supply a higher version or let SCU apply version_increment.

commands.name: store_deck
commands.summary: Store source as a new revision of a deck.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck to create or revise.

arguments.name: source_file
arguments.description: Path to the source file to store.

options.name: comment-prefix
options.description: Comment prefix for the new revision. Omit to keep the deck's prefix or use the version default for a new deck.

commands.help: Read the source file and append a deck revision to the open version. Set or change the deck's comment prefix with --comment-prefix.

commands.name: verify_audit
commands.summary: Verify the audit chain and optionally check for a saved head.

options.name: head
options.description: Previously saved SHA-256 digest to look for in the audit chain.

commands.help: Verify the audit chain. Supply a previously saved SHA-256 head to check that it is still present.
